title: Sri Lanka Family Getaway: Kandy, Bentota and Colombo
alt: Baby turtles being released on the beach at Kosgoda
transport: Private air conditioned car with an English speaking chauffeur guide throughout

stops.name: Kandy
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Standard class hotel on the Mahaweli river outside Kandy

activities.name: Private visit to Pinnawala
activities.description: A private stop at the elephant sanctuary to watch the herd bathe in the river before continuing up to Kandy.

activities.name: Private Kandy lake drive and dance show
activities.description: An evening circuit of the lake by private car, then the drummers, masked dancers and fire walkers.

activities.name: Private full day Kandy sightseeing
activities.description: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, Peradeniya gardens, a spice garden, the gem museum, Huluganga Falls and the Kadugannawa tea factory.

program.name: Kandy
program.description: Two nights by the river at Kandy with the elephants on the way in, a dance show and a private full day of temples, gardens and a tea estate.

stops.name: Bentota
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 3★ · Deluxe class beach hotel with a pool facing the sea

activities.name: Private Madu River boat ride
activities.description: A boat through the mangrove islands of the Madu Ganga, with the cinnamon island and the fish spa at the river mouth.

activities.name: Kosgoda turtle hatchery
activities.description: A visit to the hatchery where eggs are protected and the children can watch hatchlings being released.

program.name: Bentota
program.description: A night on the beach with a private Madu River boat ride and the turtle hatchery on the way in.

stops.name: Colombo
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 4★ · Four star hotel on the Mount Lavinia beachfront south of the city

activities.name: Private full day Colombo sightseeing
activities.description: Galle Face Green, the Gangaramaya temple, the colonial Fort district, the Lotus Tower and Pettah market by private car.

program.name: Colombo
program.description: A last night in the capital with a private full day of its temples, colonial quarter and markets.

day_titles.1: Arrival in Colombo and on to Kandy

1: Arrival at Bandaranaike International and private transfer inland
A private stop at the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary
Check in at your riverside hotel in Kandy
A private lake drive and the Kandyan dance performance
2: Breakfast, then the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
The Peradeniya gardens and a spice garden
Huluganga Falls and the Kadugannawa tea factory
The gem museum and dinner at the hotel
3: Breakfast and a transfer down to the coast
A private boat ride through the Madu Ganga mangroves
The Kosgoda turtle hatchery and a hatchling release
Check in at Bentota and the evening on the beach
4: Breakfast and a transfer down the coast to Colombo
Galle Face Green and the Gangaramaya temple complex
The Fort district, the Lotus Tower and Pettah market
Dinner and your last night at the hotel
5: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Bandaranaike International for your flight home

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Kandy, the hills and then the coast. Sri Lanka works best when you let the island cool you down before it warms you up again.
expert.tip: Carry a light sweater for Nuwara Eliya. It sits at nearly 1,900 metres and evenings are surprisingly chilly even in April.

summary: Five family friendly days: two nights at Kandy with the Pinnawala elephants, a dance show and a private day of temples and gardens, a night at Bentota with a Madu River boat ride and the turtle hatchery, and a last night in Colombo.
included: Included: 4 nights in standard and deluxe class hotels with breakfast and dinner daily; private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; a private Pinnawala elephant sanctuary visit; private Kandy lake drive and dance show; a private full day Kandy sightseeing tour; a private Madu River boat ride; the Kosgoda turtle hatchery; a private full day Colombo sightseeing tour; visa assistance. Entrance tickets are payable locally.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches unless stated; entrance tickets where marked as payable locally; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
